name: save_load
chapter: Saving and loading: a quicksave on the floating yacht, a walk with health lost, a quickload puts the game back where it was saved
note: Chapter 1 as chapter select starts it: Lara on yacht 998's stern deck in l1_seatop, the yacht a loose Jolt body riding the waves. The save / load input lines run ou-game's quicksave slot (ctest gives every self-test a fresh XDG_DATA_HOME; ou-game refuses save / load input without a redirected one). save.restored compares the World's whole state one tick after the save with the state one tick after the load (World::stateParts: Lara, camera, bones, physics bodies, moving collision, objects, enemies); both ticks run without input, so a save that misses any of it fails, and save.differs names the parts. The load step lasts as long as the save step, so she ends it where the save step ended (the deck heaving under her included). A save in l3_main_bedroom does not round-trip: known_gaps/save_load_bedroom_doors.

expect.note: the state after the load's first tick is the state after the save's
